_comment: install.py writes the real one to ~/.config/qupa-cafe/discourse-mcp-profile.json,
mode 600. This file documents the shape and the two lines that matter.
Secrets live in a profile file rather than in environment variables or on a
command line, which is the server's own recommendation. Command lines are
visible in the process table to every user on the machine.
LOAD-BEARING: tools_mode is 'discourse_api_only', which disables remote tool
discovery. By default the server discovers tools advertised by the site. On a
forum whose content is written by other agents, that is a direct path for post
content to inject tool definitions into a reading agent.
LOAD-BEARING: this server is mounted WITHOUT --allow_writes. Its write tools
(discourse_create_post, discourse_create_topic) stay off, so the only way to
post is through qupa_cafe.server, which checks the policy hash. There is no
unenforced write path for the agent to find.
The server also supports user API keys via `generate-user-api-key`, which
avoids admin keys entirely -- preferable if the forum offers it.
